metadata.question: Does forest cover in Petén, Guatemala decrease in 2023 compared to 2001?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Hansen Global Forest Change v1.11 (2023) global image and FAO GAUL level-1 boundaries to extract the Petén, Guatemala region. Compute forest area for end-of-2001 and end-of-2023. 2. Masking strategy: Not a cloud question. Use GFC datamask (land=1) and a 30% canopy threshold on treecover2000. For 2001 end-year, exclude pixels with lossyear=1; for 2023 end-year, exclude any lossyear>0 (keep only lossyear=0). 3. Logic for valid vs null/error: Check region lookup; compute counts of valid pixels for each mask; if zero, output C2. If any area is null/NaN, output C3. Otherwise compare 2023 vs 2001 with a small tolerance to decide A/B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { function eeGet(obj) { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { obj.evaluate((v, e) => (e ? reject(e) : resolve(v))); }); } try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const gaul = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1'); let peten = gaul .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Guatemala')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Petén')); let size1 = await eeGet(peten.size()); if (size1 === 0) { peten = gaul .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Guatemala')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Peten')); size1 = await eeGet(peten.size()); } if (size1 === 0) { peten = gaul .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Guatemala')) .filter(ee.Filter.stringContains('ADM1_NAME', 'Pet')); size1 = await eeGet(peten.size()); } if (size1 === 0) { console.log('Region lookup failed: Petén not found in GAUL.'); console.log('D'); return; } const region = peten.union(1).geometry(); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const gfc = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1.11'); const tc2000 = gfc.select('treecover2000'); const lossyear = gfc.select('lossyear'); const datamask = gfc.select('datamask').eq(1); // land // Threshold for forest const thr = 30; const baseForest = tc2000.gte(thr); // Forest masks (end of year) const forest2001 = datamask.and(baseForest).and(lossyear.neq(1)); const forest2023 = datamask.and(baseForest).and(lossyear.eq(0)); // 3. Processing: pixel counts and area (km2) at 1 km scale const areaKm2 = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6); const ones2001 = ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(forest2001); const ones2023 = ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(forest2023); const onesRegion = ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(datamask); const regArea = await eeGet( areaKm2.updateMask(datamask).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e13, }) ); const a2001 = await eeGet( areaKm2.updateMask(forest2001).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e13, }) ); const a2023 = await eeGet( areaKm2.updateMask(forest2023).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e13, }) ); const c2001 = await eeGet( ones2001.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e13, }) ); const c2023 = await eeGet( ones2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e13, }) ); const cRegion = await eeGet( onesRegion.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e13, }) ); const regionAreaKm2 = regArea ? regArea.pixelarea : null; const area2001 = a2001 ? a2001.pixelarea : null; const area2023 = a2023 ? a2023.pixelarea : null; const count2001 = c2001 ? c2001.constant : 0; const count2023 = c2023 ? c2023.constant : 0; const countRegion = cRegion ? cRegion.constant : 0; // 4. Validation if ( regionAreaKm2 === null || area2001 === null || area2023 === null || !isFinite(regionAreaKm2) || !isFinite(area2001) || !isFinite(area2023) ) { console.log('Calculation produced null/invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (count2001 === 0 || count2023 === 0) { console.log( `No valid pixels after masking. 2001_px=${count2001}, 2023_px=${count2023}` ); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Results & Final Answer const change = area2023 - area2001; const pct = (change / area2001) * 100; console.log('Region: Petén, Guatemala (GAUL 2015 L1)'); console.log('Dataset: Hansen GFC v1.11, forest ≥30% canopy, land mask applied'); console.log( `Region land area (km²): ${Math.round(regionAreaKm2)} | Cells(1km): ${countRegion}` ); console.log( `2001 end-year forest (km²): ${Math.round(area2001)} | Cells: ${count2001}` ); console.log( `2023 end-year forest (km²): ${Math.round(area2023)} | Cells: ${count2023}` ); console.log( `Change (km²): ${Math.round(change)} | Change (% of 2001): ${pct.toFixed(2)}` ); // Tolerance to avoid rounding artifacts const tolKm2 = Math.max(1, 0.001 * area2001); const decreased = area2023 < area2001 - tolKm2; console.log(decreased ? 'A' : 'B'); } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
